build_TestModel: build a TestModel with a given number of actions for Atari RL policy and baseline output
build_ShallowModel: build a ShallowModel with conv layers and optional LSTM for Atari RL policy and baseline output
build_Model: build a ResNet-based Model with optional LSTM for Atari RL policy and baseline output
run_get_model: run get_model to instantiate a TestModel, ShallowModel, or ResNet Model by flag
review_Model_forward: review the Model forward pass that processes observations through ResNet convs and LSTM core
